cohort: 100 pregnant teenagers at a hospital in Kadapa, India, from October 2019 to September 2021.
finding: Teenage pregnancy was associated with various complications including anemia, PIH disorders, oligohydramnios, CPD, and a high rate of cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: 60% of the teenage pregnancies resulted in cesarean delivery, 1% in instrumental delivery, and 39% in vaginal delivery; cesarean delivery was primarily indicated due to CPD, oligohydramnios, malpresentation, and prior cesarean section.
